description: Ground truth for the advisor's flags, from the simulator. Committed before the code that scores it. Each run is one family and seed from eval/scenarios.json under Titra's controller. A window is the last window_s seconds ending at end_s. expect: flags that should be raised. allow: flags that may also be raised without counting as a false alarm. Any other flag is a false alarm. The frequent_desaturations flag is scored against the simulator's true saturation, which the flag never sees: expected when true dips (below `below` for at least min_s) reach flag_at_per_h, a false alarm when they stay under clear_below_per_h, and not scored in between. Thresholds are tuned on the development seeds; the held-out seeds are run once, after tuning ends.
